WhitneyBeforeText:
Hi! I'm WHITNEY!

Everyone was into
#MON, so I got into it too!

#MON are
super-cute!

You want to bat-
tle? I'm warning you--I'm good!
WhitneyShouldntBeSoSeriousText:
Sob…

…Waaaaaaah!
You're mean!

You shouldn't be
so serious! You… you child, you!
WhitneyWhatDoYouWantText:
…Sniff…

What? What do you
want? A BADGE?

Oh, right.
I forgot. Here's PLAINBADGE.
WhitneyPlainBadgeText:
PLAINBADGE lets
your #MON use

STRENGTH outside
of battle.

It also boosts
your #MON's SPEED.

Oh, you can have
this too!
WhitneyAttractText:
It's ATTRACT!
It makes full use

of a #MON's
charm.

Isn't it just per-
fect for a cutie like me?
WhitneyGoodCryText:
Ah, that was a
good cry!

Come for a visit
again! Bye-bye!
LassCarrieSeenText:
Don't let my
#MON's cute

looks fool you.
They can whip you!
LassCarrieBeatenText:
Darn… I thought
you were weak…
LassBridgetSeenText:
I like cute #-
MON better than strong #MON.

But I have strong
and cute #MON!
LassBridgetAfterBattleText:
I'm trying to beat
WHITNEY, but… It's depressing.

I'm okay! If I
lose, I'll just

try harder next
time!
BridgetWhitneyCriesText:
Oh, no. You made
WHITNEY cry.

It's OK. She'll
stop soon. She

always cries when
she loses.
BeautyVictoriaSeenText:
Oh, you are a cute
little trainer! 

I like you, but I
won't hold back!
BeautyVictoriaAfterBattleText:
Wow, you must be
good to beat me! Keep it up!
BeautySamanthaSeenText:
Give it your best
shot, or I'll take you down!
BeautySamanthaBeatenText:
No! Oh, MEOWTH,
I'm so sorry!
BeautySamanthaAfterBattleText:
I taught MEOWTH
moves for taking on any type…
GoldenrodGymGuideText:
Yo! CHAMP in
making!

This GYM is home
to normal-type #MON trainers.

I recommend you
use fighting-type #MON.
GoldenrodGymGuideWinText:
You won? Great! I
was busy admiring the ladies here.
